## Full text

- **Fetched:** 39 of 284 corpus papers (13.7%): JATS XML from Europe PMC or PMC, or an open PDF found through Unpaywall (`fetch_fulltext.py`). Access status in the corpus: paywalled 195, not_found 50, europepmc_xml 27, publisher_pdf 9, pmc_efetch_xml 3.
- **Unpaywall** open PDFs were fetched on 2026-10-20 (D-32: open access only). Of the papers still without full text, 62 more list a free or open copy outside PMC in Europe PMC (`oa_elsewhere.json`); with them, at most 101 of 284 (35.6%). Not fetched.
- **Relevance yes, primary papers** (case reports and series): 186; with full text 24 (12.9%).
- **Full-text screening** (`screen_fulltext_v1.md`; `screening_fulltext/screening_log.json`): exclude 8, include 31, not_accessible 245. Exclusion reasons: not_disease 3, not_english 1, review_no_new_individuals 4.
- **Eligible with full text:** 31 papers, of which 28 primary reports (case reports and series) and 1 with a per-patient literature table (D-33).
